fullPassage: The film production industry extensively utilizes AI in various ways. This is because it not only assists producers in creating films more conveniently, but also enables them to make what they intended to express come alive with enhanced realism and naturalness. Recently, an AI-based program was developed, through which actors’ faces on the screen are aged or made younger. For example, when provided with the input of a thirty-five-year-old man’s face, the AI program generates different facial images at different ages. While there have been existing techniques that can achieve similar results, they required an extensive process. However, the newly developed automatic program accelerates the process. In order to develop this program, thousands of pictures of faces ranging from eighteen years old to eighty-five years old were accumulated as input to this program. It was then trained to learn how faces change as people age, and derived the principles for aging. With them, the program can manipulate the facial changes of actors with the addition or removal of wrinkles. As a result, it can produce output that is highly realistic. These results are maintained even when the actors make varied facial expressions. Due to the convenience and the naturalness of the results, it is expected that this technique will be widely incorporated in filmmaking.

❌ ① ignore: 무시하다 (얼굴 변화를 다루는 문맥과 무관)
✅ ② control: 조작하다, 다루다 ← 정답. 주름을 더하거나 없애 얼굴 변화를 '조작한다'는 문맥과 같은 의미
❌ ③ damage: 손상시키다 (기술적 조작과 다른 부정적 의미)
❌ ④ reveal: 드러내다 (조작과 무관한 의미)
det.tip: manipulate the facial changes = control(얼굴 변화를 조작하다)

questions.passage: The film production industry extensively utilizes AI in various ways.  This is because it not only assists producers in creating films more conveniently, but also enables them to make what they intended to express come alive with <u>enhanced</u> realism and naturalness.  Recently, an AI-based program was developed, through which actors’ faces on the screen are aged or made younger.  For example, when provided with the input of a thirty-five-year-old man’s face, the AI program generates different facial images at different ages.  While there have been existing techniques that can achieve similar results, they required an extensive process.  However, the newly developed automatic program accelerates the process.  In order to develop this program, thousands of pictures of faces ranging from eighteen years old to eighty-five years old were accumulated as input to this program.  It was then trained to learn how faces change as people age, and derived the principles for aging.  With them, the program can manipulate the facial changes of actors with the addition or removal of wrinkles.  As a result, it can produce output that is highly realistic.  These results are maintained even when the actors make varied facial expressions.  Due to the convenience and the naturalness of the results, it is expected that this technique will be widely incorporated in filmmaking.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 enhanced와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① improved: 향상된 (enhanced와 같은 의미라 반대가 아님)
✅ ② weakened: 약화된 ← 정답. '향상된(enhanced)' 사실성이라는 문맥의 반대
❌ ③ colored: 색을 입힌 (의미축이 다른 단어)
❌ ④ enlarged: 확대된 (크기의 문제라 의미축이 다름)
det.tip: enhanced realism(향상된 사실성) ↔ weakened(약화된)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 extensive와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① thorough: 철저한 (extensive와 비슷한 의미라 반대가 아님)
❌ ② complex: 복잡한 (범위가 아닌 복잡도의 문제라 의미축이 다름)
❌ ③ costly: 비용이 많이 드는 (비용의 문제라 의미축이 다름)
✅ ④ limited: 제한된 ← 정답. 기존 기술이 요구하던 '광범위한(extensive)' 과정이라는 문맥의 반대
det.tip: an extensive process(광범위한 과정) ↔ limited(제한된)

questions.passage:
(A) The film restoration <u>process</u> took several months to complete. Each damaged frame had to be checked and repaired by hand.
(B) Modern computers can <u>process</u> huge amounts of visual data in just a few seconds. This lets filmmakers turn raw footage into finished scenes almost instantly.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B) 두 문장에서 밑줄 친 process의 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) The film restoration process는 여러 달이 걸린 복원 '과정'이라는 명사이고, (B) can process huge amounts of data는 대량의 데이터를 '처리하다'라는 동사 ← 정답
❌ ② (A)는 '처리하다'가 아니라 명사 '과정'이며 (B)와 순서가 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ (A)는 '소송'이 아니라 '과정'
❌ ④ (B)는 '행진'이 아니라 '처리하다'
det.tip: process: (A) 명사 - 과정 / (B) 동사 - 처리하다

questions.stem:
다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"to control or handle something skillfully, often to change or adjust it"

det.analysis:
❌ ① ignore: 무시하다 (다루는 것과 반대되는 행동)
❌ ② damage: 손상시키다 (능숙하게 조정하는 의미와 다름)
✅ ③ manipulate: 조작하다, 능숙하게 다루다 (무언가를 능숙하게 통제·조정하는 것) ← 정답. 프로그램이 얼굴 변화를 조작하는 것이 그 예
❌ ④ reveal: 드러내다 (조작·조정과 무관한 의미)
det.tip: manipulate = 무언가를 능숙하게 다루거나 조정하다

questions.passage: The film production industry extensively utilizes AI in various ways. This is because it not only assists producers in creating films more __________ (convenient), but also enables them to make what they intended to express come alive with enhanced realism and naturalness.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.analysis: convenient(형용사, 편리한) → conveniently(부사, 편리하게): 빈칸은 동사구 creating films(영화를 만드는 것)를 수식하는 자리이므로 부사가 와야 한다. '더 편리하게 만든다'라는 뜻이 되도록 형용사 convenient를 부사 conveniently로 바꾼다.
det.tip: creating films more __(동사 수식) → conveniently

questions.passage: In order to develop this program, thousands of pictures of faces ranging from eighteen years old to eighty-five years old were __________ (accumulate) as input to this program. It was then trained to learn how faces change as people age, and derived the principles for aging.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.analysis: accumulate(동사원형, 축적하다) → accumulated(과거분사): 빈칸은 주어 thousands of pictures가 '축적되는' 대상이고 앞에 were가 있으므로 'were + 과거분사'의 수동태 형태가 와야 한다. '축적되었다'라는 뜻이 되도록 accumulate를 accumulated로 바꾼다.
det.tip: were __ as input(수동태) → accumulated

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① come alive: 제작자가 의도한 표현을 향상된 사실성과 자연스러움으로 '생생하게 살려낸다'는 문맥에 적절 ← 정답
